params.body:
The first `relations:sync` on GLK's Bouwsoft (15 October, since 1 January 2023) showed two things the field list did not:

- **Bouwsoft's Orders holds invoices too.** Of 6,256 lines, 4,658 were `FAKTUUR` and 60 `CREDITNOTA`; only 1,538 were quotes (`OFFERTE`). The invoices are already counted through SalesInvoices, so they were counted twice, and "Van offerte tot order" treated them as quotes.
- **GLK does not mark quotes accepted or rejected.** Of the 1,538 quotes, 5 were accepted and 1 rejected; the rest are "open". An acceptance rate from those flags says nothing.

Also every purchase line carries the cost category "Volledig Project", which says nothing about the supplier.

## What changes

- Lines in Orders whose type is an invoice or a credit note are skipped (`/fa[ck]tuur|invoice|credit/i`). Only quotes (and any order type that is not an invoice) remain.
- A quote that Bouwsoft leaves open gets its outcome from the invoices: **gefactureerd** when its project got a sales invoice on or after the quote date (decided on that first invoice), **geen factuur** when nothing came within 180 days (`RelationSync::QUOTE_WAIT_DAYS`), otherwise still **open**. An explicit accepted or rejected in Bouwsoft still wins.
- The page counts **gewonnen** (accepted or invoiced), **niet gewonnen** (rejected, or no invoice after six months) and **nog open**, and the median is now "from quote to first invoice". The note under the tab says how this is derived, including that a quote without a project cannot be invoiced and counts as not won after six months.
- "Volledig Project" is dropped as a category, so the supplier's projects show without it.
- The CSV column `aanvaard` becomes `gewonnen`.

## Tests

`NetworkTest` gains an invoice in Orders (skipped), an open quote invoiced afterwards (won), an old open quote without an invoice (not won), and a "Volledig Project" line (no category). Full suite 226/226, pint clean.

## After merge

Run the sync once more on the server, from a fresh shell in the site's `current` folder:

    php artisan relations:sync
params.title: Netwerk: count quotes only, and derive won or not won from the invoices after
